archetypes.name: log-schema-migration
archetypes.rationale: Three audit scans migrate from raw file inspection to reviewer_signals[] in round-meta.json; backward compat and graceful-skip semantics need independent review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the migration of ns-retry-sidecars, codex-generalist-waste, and trailing-content-no-issues-found scans in .claude/skills/audit-runs/scripts/audit-scan-run.sh from raw file-glob/grep-pattern inspection to reading reviewer_signals[] from round-meta.json. Examine whether the fallback 'skip' result (emitted when signals are unavailable) is the right semantic: specifically, could legacy concise logs that predate this change produce false-clean audit passes instead of explicit skips? Check whether _audit_reviewer_signals_jq's unavailability detection is complete — it returns 'unavailable' only when no round has a non-empty reviewer_signals array; verify this correctly handles runs where round-meta.json exists but reviewer_signals is absent or empty. Also review the ns-retry-sidecars hybrid path that falls back to physical sidecar file presence for orphan files whose ns_retry_reason is absent from signals; check whether the orphan-detection logic (output_base derivation from sidecar filename) is correct and handles edge cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-gate-regression
archetypes.rationale: larch-log.sh now debug-gates dyn-*-codex-output*, vote-output*, and *-ns-retry* families that were previously default-included; design-log-publish.sh gates plan.diff and composed-plan.diff; these are breaking changes for existing audit consumers and log readers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changes to round_artifact_included() in scripts/larch-log.sh, focusing on files that moved from default-include to LARCH_FLUSH_DEBUG=1-only: dyn-*-codex-output*, *-vote-output*.txt, *-ns-retry*.txt, and their sidecars. Check whether any existing consumer outside audit-scan-run.sh (e.g. fluff-analysis.py, review-findings-classification, report-tokens) reads these artifact families from committed logs and would silently lose data after this change. Also review the design-log-publish.sh changes that gate plan.diff and composed-plan.diff behind LARCH_FLUSH_DEBUG=1 and that add findings.md/findings-oos.md/plan-review-slots.ndjson/voting-tally.md to the exclusion list — but note voting-tally.md gets _include_excluded=true in the top-level loop (lines ~903-913); verify this carve-out is intentional and correct. Examine whether the new design_artifact_excluded cases for findings.md and friends in design-log-publish.sh correctly match the lib-design-round-artifacts.sh allowlist so no unexpected 'unexpected file' log errors occur at round level. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
